pages.text: For your first wagon, choose a standard wagon box, a single wooden driver’s seat and single-horse shafts.$(br2)You need:$(li)1 assembly jack$(li)1 wagon box$(li)1 driver’s seat$(li)1 set of shafts$(li)2 small and 2 large wheels$(br2)Bring an adult horse or donkey and a lead.

One small-wheel recipe makes two wheels. Upgrade small wheels to make large ones. Parts on the same wagon may use different woods.$(br2)Recipes below show oak examples; their captions explain material rules. Continue with $(l:tm_wagon:start/assembly)Six-Step Assembly$(/l).

pages.heading: book.tm_wagon.recipe
pages.text: Use any planks, including modded planks. The jack has no wood variants.

pages.heading: book.tm_wagon.recipe
pages.text: Planks, logs or stripped logs, and the trapdoor must all match. Vanilla woods only; bamboo is excluded.

pages.heading: book.tm_wagon.recipe
pages.text: Matching planks determine the seat’s wood.

pages.heading: book.tm_wagon.recipe
pages.text: Use any log or stripped log in the middle. Shafts have no wood variants.

pages.heading: book.tm_wagon.recipe
pages.text: The log or stripped log determines the wood. Produces two wheels.

pages.heading: book.tm_wagon.recipe
pages.text: Inherits the small wheel’s wood. The surrounding planks may be any wood.
